briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Rescheduling Holds, Psychedelics Go Mainstream, Michigan Eyes a Tax Reset
briefs.top: Federal momentum is real this week: a landmark FDA psychedelics hearing, Eli Lilly's psychedelics buyout, and a court win for medical marijuana's Schedule III status all point toward a more open national market. In Michigan, operators are pushing back on the 24% wholesale tax with a fresh lawsuit and a bipartisan repeal bill, while brands like Fields Cannary keep building for what comes next.
